desc: Help › Two-edged Sword Help (⌘?) opens the help drawer; the guides written into each Ask chat's folder
The help drawer: ?, the top bar's ? button or ⌘? open the docs/ guide for the current screen, with search and Ask about the app
KJV History screen: the KJV's family tree with library status, and Ask seeded with it
The user guides in docs/ built in for the help drawer: parsed into sections, mapped to screens, searched, rendered as HTML
Differences from the KJV: loads variances-<module>.json, the ≠ popup
Converts CrossWire SWORD modules (Peshitta, Tyndale, Geneva, DRC) to e-Sword Bibles
make help: checks every link in the user guides and each screen's help section resolves to a heading
Builds Targum Bibles and Talmud books (with verse links) from Sefaria's export
Checks reviewed variance batches and merges them into variances-<module>.json
Finds verses where a translation may differ from the KJV, in batches for review
Builds the Clementine Vulgate in KJV verse numbering
